mapper.select: SELECT l.lecture_id AS lectureId, l.thumbnail AS thumbnail, l.name AS title, u.nickname AS nickname, u.user_type AS userType, l.outline AS outline, l.introduction AS introduction, l.price AS price, l.discount_rate AS discountRate, COALESCE(review_stats.reviewNum, 0) AS reviewNum, COALESCE(review_stats.avgReviewRate, 0.0) AS avgReviewRate, l.student_num AS studentNum, l.difficulty AS difficulty, l.lecture_status as lectureStatus, l.bookmark_num AS bookmarkNum, COALESCE(lcpr.progress_rate, 0.0) AS progressRate, COALESCE(cat_info.big_category, 'IT/개발') AS big, COALESCE(cat_info.small_category, '웹 개발') AS small FROM lecture_content_progress_rate lcpr INNER JOIN lecture l ON lcpr.lecture_id = l.lecture_id INNER JOIN user u ON l.uploader_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN user_lecture ul ON ul.lecture_id = l.lecture_id AND ul.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT lf.lecture_id, c.name AS big_category, -- category 테이블의 name (대분류) i.NAME AS small_category -- interested 테이블의 NAME (소분류, 대문자) FROM lecture_field lf JOIN interested i ON lf.interested_id = i.interested_id JOIN category c ON i.category_id = c.category_id ) cat_info ON cat_info.lecture_id = l.lecture_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT lecture_id, COUNT(*) AS reviewNum, AVG(review_rate) AS avgReviewRate -- review_rate 컬럼 사용 FROM review GROUP BY lecture_id ) review_stats ON review_stats.lecture_id = l.lecture_id WHERE lcpr.student_id = #{userId} ORDER BY lcpr.last_update_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT l.lecture_id AS lectureId, l.thumbnail AS thumbnail, l.name AS title, u.nickname AS nickname, u.user_type AS userType, l.outline AS outline, l.introduction AS introduction, l.price AS price, l.discount_rate AS discountRate, COALESCE(review_stats.reviewNum, 0) AS reviewNum, COALESCE(review_stats.avgReviewRate, 0.0) AS avgReviewRate, l.student_num AS studentNum, l.difficulty AS difficulty, l.lecture_status as lectureStatus, l.bookmark_num AS bookmarkNum, 0.0 AS progressRate, -- 진도율은 별도 조회 필요 COALESCE(cat_info.big_category, 'IT/개발') AS big, COALESCE(cat_info.small_category, '웹 개발') AS small FROM lecture l INNER JOIN user u ON l.uploader_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT lf.lecture_id, c.name AS big_category, i.NAME AS small_category FROM lecture_field lf JOIN interested i ON lf.interested_id = i.interested_id JOIN category c ON i.category_id = c.category_id ) cat_info ON cat_info.lecture_id = l.lecture_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT lecture_id, COUNT(*) AS reviewNum, AVG(review_rate) AS avgReviewRate FROM review GROUP BY lecture_id ) review_stats ON review_stats.lecture_id = l.lecture_id WHERE l.lecture_id = #{lectureId}
SELECT lecture_chapter_id AS chapterId, lc.`name`, order_num AS orderNum, lc.objective FROM lecture_chapter AS lc WHERE lc.lecture_id = #{lectureId} ORDER BY lc.order_num ASC

SELECT lm.lecture_material_id as matId, lc.lecture_content_id as conId, af.`name`, lc.name as contentName FROM lecture_chapter lch JOIN lecture_content lc ON lch.lecture_chapter_id = lc.lecture_chapter_id JOIN lecture_material lm ON lc.lecture_material_id = lm.lecture_material_id JOIN additional_file af ON lm.lecture_material_id = af.additional_file_id WHERE lch.lecture_chapter_id = #{lectureChapterId} AND lm.type = 3 -- 추가자료 타입 ORDER BY lc.lecture_content_id

SELECT lm.lecture_material_id as matId, lc.lecture_content_id as conId, lvm.`name`, lc.name as contentName FROM lecture_chapter lch JOIN lecture_content lc ON lch.lecture_chapter_id = lc.lecture_chapter_id JOIN lecture_material lm ON lc.lecture_material_id = lm.lecture_material_id JOIN lecture_video_material lvm ON lm.lecture_material_id = lvm.lecture_material_id WHERE lch.lecture_chapter_id = #{lectureChapterId} AND lm.type = 2 -- 영상 타입 ORDER BY lc.lecture_content_id

SELECT q.question, lm.lecture_material_id as matId, lc.lecture_content_id as conId, q.question_id as questionId, lc.name as contentName FROM lecture_chapter lch JOIN lecture_content lc ON lch.lecture_chapter_id = lc.lecture_chapter_id JOIN lecture_material lm ON lc.lecture_material_id = lm.lecture_material_id JOIN lecture_question_material lqm ON lm.lecture_material_id = lqm.lecture_material_id JOIN question q ON q.question_id = lqm.question_id WHERE lch.lecture_chapter_id = #{lectureChapterId} AND lm.type = 1 -- 문제 타입 ORDER BY lc.lecture_content_id

SELECT af.additional_file_id as matId, lc.lecture_content_id as conId, lc.discription as comment, af.`name`, af.address, af.`format` FROM lecture_material AS lm JOIN additional_file AS af ON lm.lecture_material_id = af.additional_file_id JOIN lecture_content AS lc ON lc.lecture_material_id = lm.lecture_material_id WHERE lm.lecture_material_id = #{lectureMaterialId}

SELECT lvm.lecture_material_id as matId, lc.lecture_content_id as conId, lvm.`name`, lvm.address, lvm.`comment` FROM lecture_material AS lm JOIN lecture_video_material AS lvm ON lm.lecture_material_id = lvm.lecture_material_id JOIN lecture_content AS lc ON lc.lecture_material_id = lm.lecture_material_id WHERE lm.lecture_material_id = #{lectureMaterialId}

SELECT q.question, lm.lecture_material_id as matId, lc.lecture_content_id as conId, q.question_id as questionId, q.choice_answer, q.`type`, q.answer, q.`comment` FROM lecture_material AS lm JOIN lecture_question_material AS lqm ON lm.lecture_material_id = lqm.lecture_material_id JOIN question AS q ON q.question_id = lqm.question_id JOIN lecture_content AS lc ON lc.lecture_material_id = lm.lecture_material_id WHERE lm.lecture_material_id = #{lectureMaterialId}

SELECT u.nickname, u.profilename, lcq.question_date as questionDate, lcq.question_content as questionContent, lcq.answer_content as answerContent, lcq.answer_date as answerDate FROM lecture_material AS lm JOIN lecture_content AS lc ON lc.lecture_material_id = lm.lecture_material_id JOIN lecture_content_qna AS lcq ON lcq.lecture_content_id = lc.lecture_content_id JOIN user AS u ON u.user_id = lcq.questional_id WHERE lm.lecture_material_id = #{materialId};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lecture ( lecture_id, uploader_id, thumbnail, name, outline, introduction, price, discount_rate, difficulty ) VALUES ( generate_lecture_id(), #{uploaderId}, #{thumbnail}, #{name}, #{outline}, #{introduction}, #{price}, #{discountRate}, #{difficulty} )
INSERT INTO lecture_chapter ( lecture_id, name, objective, order_num ) VALUES ( #{lectureId}, #{name}, #{objective}, #{orderNum} )
INSERT INTO lecture_content ( lecture_chapter_id, lecture_material_id, name, discription ) VALUES ( #{lectureChapterId}, #{lectureMaterialId}, #{name}, #{discription} )
INSERT INTO additional_file ( additional_file_id, name, address, format ) VALUES ( #{additionalFileId}, #{name}, #{address}, #{format} )
INSERT INTO lecture_video_material ( lecture_material_id, name, address, comment ) VALUES ( #{lectureMaterialId}, #{name}, #{address}, #{comment} )
INSERT INTO question ( question, choice_answer, type, answer, comment ) VALUES ( #{question}, #{choiceAnswer}, #{type}, #{answer}, #{comment} )
mapper.update:
INSERT INTO completed_materials (user_id, lecture_id, material_id, completed_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{lectureId}, #{materialId}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE completed_date = NOW();
INSERT INTO lecture_content_progress_rate (lecture_id, student_id, progress_rate, last_update_date) VALUES ( #{lectureId}, #{userId}, ( SELECT ROUND( ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cm.material_id) FROM completed_materials cm WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} AND cm.lecture_id = #{lectureId} ) * 100.0 / ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lecture_material lm INNER JOIN lecture_content lc ON lm.lecture_material_id = lc.lecture_material_id INNER JOIN lecture_chapter lch ON lc.lecture_chapter_id = lch.lecture_chapter_id WHERE lch.lecture_id = #{lectureId} ), 1 ) ), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE progress_rate = VALUES(progress_rate), last_update_date = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT lcpr.lecture_id as lectureId, l.name as lectureName, lcpr.progress_rate as progressRate, lcpr.last_update_date as lastUpdateDate, l.lecture_status as lectureStatus, CASE WHEN l.uploader_id = #{userId} THEN 'instructor' ELSE 'student' END as uploaderType FROM lecture_content_progress_rate lcpr INNER JOIN lecture l ON lcpr.lecture_id = l.lecture_id WHERE lcpr.student_id = #{userId} AND lcpr.lecture_id = #{lectureId}

SELECT lcpr.lecture_id, lcpr.student_id, lcpr.progress_rate, lcpr.last_update_date, l.name as lecture_name, -- 🎯 완료된 자료 수 계산 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cm.material_id) FROM completed_materials cm WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} AND cm.lecture_id = #{lectureId}) as completed_materials_count, -- 🎯 전체 자료 수 계산 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lecture_material lm INNER JOIN lecture_content lc ON lm.lecture_material_id = lc.lecture_material_id INNER JOIN lecture_chapter lch ON lc.lecture_chapter_id = lch.lecture_chapter_id WHERE lch.lecture_id = #{lectureId}) as total_materials_count, -- 🎯 실시간 진도율 계산 ROUND( CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lecture_material lm INNER JOIN lecture_content lc ON lm.lecture_material_id = lc.lecture_material_id INNER JOIN lecture_chapter lch ON lc.lecture_chapter_id = lch.lecture_chapter_id WHERE lch.lecture_id = #{lectureId}) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE ( (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cm.material_id) FROM completed_materials cm WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} AND cm.lecture_id = #{lectureId}) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lecture_material lm INNER JOIN lecture_content lc ON lm.lecture_material_id = lc.lecture_material_id INNER JOIN lecture_chapter lch ON lc.lecture_chapter_id = lch.lecture_chapter_id WHERE lch.lecture_id = #{lectureId}) ) END, 1 ) as real_time_progress_rate FROM lecture_content_progress_rate lcpr INNER JOIN lecture l ON lcpr.lecture_id = l.lecture_id WHERE lcpr.student_id = #{userId} AND lcpr.lecture_id = #{lectureId}

SELECT lecture_id as lectureId, uploader_id as uploaderId, thumbnail, name, outline, introduction, price, discount_rate as discountRate, difficulty, lecture_status as lectureStatus, upload_date as uploadDate FROM lecture WHERE lecture_id = #{lectureId}
mapper.update: UPDATE lecture SET thumbnail = #{thumbnail}, name = #{name}, outline = #{outline}, introduction = #{introduction}, price = #{price}, discount_rate = #{discountRate}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, update_date = NOW() WHERE lecture_id = #{lectureId}
